description.narrative: The most significant Project outcomes are the benefits of increasing high-quality warehousing infrastructure for third party logistics and downstream industries (e.g., manufacturing and e-commerce) across tier 2 and 3 cities of India, and the environmental benefits of increasing EDGE certification in commercial buildings. At the market level, the investment contributes to develop the sustainable debt financing market by stimulating sustainability-linked bond issuances and better integrating logistic infrastructure to capital markets. IFC investment also contributes promote greater market competitiveness in warehousing and logistics.

The proposed IFC investment is a senior secured loan of up to US$150 million through subscription to non-convertible listed debt securities/debentures to be issued by NDR InvIT Trust (the InvIT or NDR). The said investment and any future investments up to the amount approved by the Board would be made in multiple tranches. NDR is a AAA-rated entity that is Indias first and largest warehousing infrastructure investment trust (InvIT) with a market capitalization of US$481 million as of October 2024. NDR currently owns and manages close to 17 million square feet (sq. ft) of warehousing space across 33 parks in India. This warehousing space is contracted out on long-term contracts with a fixed payment stream to a diversified set of national and multinational customers. NDR InvIT Managers Private Limited serves as the IM for the NDR InvIT Trust.
